slopball3d — cooperative 3D physics soccer with Kit

2 min readOdin × GodotPage source ↓
On this page ↓
3D physics and rotationRun itAutomated tests

Use this Kit example to replicate 3D Godot physics bodies. The ball is a RigidBody3D that arcs, bounces and tumbles; players are CharacterBody3D capsules. play.Puppet3 lets the ball's entity owner simulate it and stream its pose and momentum, while other peers freeze their solver and display the received state.

3D physics and rotation#

The 3D version uses the same Session, streams, deltas, commands, chat, and lobby APIs. A kicker streams position as one pos: [3]f32 field. Its physics and rotation use these rules:

  • play.Puppet3 streams rot: gd.Quaternion with the .Quat interpolation kind, using nlerp with hemisphere correction. The 2D puppet uses snapped angles; directly interpolating their scalar values across ±π would take the long arc.
  • Ownership transfer seeds angular velocity as well as linear velocity, preserving the ball's tumble and rolling motion.
  • Impose poses through PhysicsServer3D.body_set_state, as for the 2D version, because solver synchronization can replace direct node transforms.
  • Ownership arbitration uses ground-plane XZ distance, anticipates contact, retains possession, and gates claims on input. puppet3_claim predicts possession locally; render-error smoothing and physics interpolation apply only to presentation and reset at cuts. Kicks add a y impulse for loft.

See the 2D ownership and timing guide for the shared session and presentation rules.

Run it#

From examples/slopball3d, build once with bash ../../build/build_scripts.sh ., then open two windows on one machine:

Shell
SLOP3_NAME=lefty  godot --path .    # Host
SLOP3_NAME=righty godot --path .    # Join

WASD moves on the pitch plane, Space kicks (lofted), first to SLOP3_GOALS (default 3) takes the match. Odd seats defend the left goal, even the right.

Automated tests#

  • run.sh — solo gate (SLOPBALL3D_SINGLE_OK): the striker bot runs the whole loop headless, exercising the 3D physics solver under --headless.
  • native_run.sh — 3-peer integration test (SLOPBALL3D_NATIVE_OK): host + striker + watcher. The seat transfers to the striker client, its local solver (gravity, tumble) scores, and the three screens agree on the ball within centimeters at the same session tick.
